projectDescription: BRIEF is an AI Conversation Intelligence & Memory platform that captures important spoken conversations, understands what happened, turns them into useful outcomes, and remembers them — with Arabic and privacy at the core.
keyFeatures: Offline-first conversation capture — records with no internet required
Arabic + English + code-switch speech recognition, tuned for Egyptian and Gulf dialects
Automatic conversation classification (Professional or Generic) with type-specific structured outputs
Speaker diarization and label identification (who said what)
Three processing modes: fully on-device (Mode A), hybrid (Mode B), and cloud-enhanced (Mode C)
Consent-first recording with a configurable Recording Policy Engine
Privacy Center with per-conversation processing transparency and data deletion controls
Conversation Archive (AI Memory) — searchable history with provenance-linked facts
WhatsApp-ready share, PDF export, and bilingual Arabic/English outputs
Subscription tiers across Free, Starter, Pro, Business, and Enterprise with separate Egypt and GCC pricing
publicApiSurface: Professional Conversation output: summary, key points, decisions, action items, owners, deadlines, risks, requirements, commitments, follow-ups
Generic Conversation output: summary, key points, questions, action items, important moments
Speaker Labels: per-conversation speaker identification with LLM name inference and one-tap correction
Processing Mode selection: Mode A (on-device), Mode B (hybrid), Mode C (cloud)
Privacy Center: per-conversation data transparency, delete audio, delete conversation, export data, revoke cloud consent
Conversation Archive: history view, basic search, search-within-conversation, fact retrieval with provenance
Share and export: WhatsApp, PDF, DOCX, copy, bilingual output
